name: print-social-market-value-carousel-violet-lime-with-circle-photos
title: Three-slide 'Market Value' carousel in violet, lime and white with circle-cropped photos
whatItIs: Three portrait slides: 'What Does "Market Value" Really Mean?' with the term in a lime pill, 'Why Market Value Actually Matters to You', and a white 'That Shape Your Market Value' slide; team photos in circles ringed in white or lime, violet ring shapes and arrows.
whatItMeans: Punchy and educational; the pill highlight turns a dry business term into a scroll-friendly hook.
techniques: Put the key term in a highlighter pill inside the headline.
Crop photos into rings that bleed across slide edges.
Flip one slide to white to break carousel rhythm.
Use big arrows to push the swipe.

vocabulary.definition: A multi-slide social post swiped horizontally.
A coloured capsule behind a word for emphasis.
